title:
This is an epic to Close/Reopen cases depending on it's current state.
If {@link ReliabilityAssetCase#currentState} is `Closed`:
  Transition {@link ReliabilityAssetCase#currentState} from `Closed` to `Open`.
  Update `secondaryActionButtonTitleForCase` in {@link ReliabilityApplicationState}.
Else if {@link ReliabilityAssetCase#currentState} is `Open`:
  Open `Reliability.CloseCaseModal` to confirm closing and submit feedback as handled by {@link UiSdlEpicCloseCaseDetails}
name: UiSdlEpicOpenCloseCase
